description: Source code for loading, validating, and managing Playwright configuration files, including functions for resolving config locations, loading configs, validating config structure, and handling ESM loader setup.

methods.name: defineConfig
methods.description: Function to define and merge multiple configuration objects, setting a symbol to indicate usage.

methods.name: deserializeConfig
methods.description: Function to deserialize a serialized config object, optionally adding to the compilation cache.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Main function to load and validate a Playwright configuration from a given location, with options for overrides and ignoring project dependencies.

methods.name: loadUserConfig
methods.description: Function to load user configuration file, handling default exports.

methods.name: loadConfigFromFile
methods.description: Function to load configuration directly from a specified file path.

methods.name: loadEmptyConfigForMergeReports
methods.description: Function to load an empty configuration for report merging purposes.
